Name: Boba Tea Cafe
Author: TylerCode
Description:
[u][size=6]Boba Cafe[/size]
[/u]
This mod provides new recipes to add several flavors of boba tea into the game as well as supporting crops (cassava) which are harvested into tapioca. Recipes incorporate green tea made from tea leaves, which you unlock after getting to heart level 5 with Caroline.

[b][size=4]How it works:[/size][/b]
[size=3]The boba chain is built around [b]Tapioca[/b]:

1. [b]Cassava[/b] | grow it from Cassava Seeds (Pierre, spring/summer).
2. [b]Tapioca[/b] | cook [b]Sugar + Cassava[/b] in the kitchen. 
3. [b]Green Boba Tea[/b] | cook Green Tea + Tapioca + Milk. This is the base boba.
4. [b]Flavored bobas |[/b] add a fruit to the base: Strawberry, Cherry, Melon, or Grape.
5. [b]Iced Coffee Boba |[/b] cook Coffee + Tapioca + Milk.[/size]

First recipe is given by Caroline in Summer of year 1 in the mail. Purchase cassava seeds from Pierre in Spring and Summer. Crops are available every year from Spring through Summer. More recipes are given after the first as you level up your hearts with Caroline. Half will come in year 1, the rest coming after year 2.

Feedback is encouraged and appreciated so please report and mod incompatibilities, bugs, flavor suggestions, balancing or any other feedback you have.

Minimal dependencies needed to make it an easy install. Bugs or incompatibilities can be reported on modnexus or more preferably, on [url=https://github.com/TylerCode/BobaCafe]GitHub[/url]. 

Recipes Added:
- Green Tea Boba
- Cherry Boba
- Grape Boba
- Iced Coffee Boba
- Melon Boba
- Strawberry Boba
- Tapioca


Compatible With:
• PPJA Fruits and Veggies
• Artisan Valley
• PPJA More Recipes
